'''Magnispecs''' were worn by a being and made items appear larger. Magnispecs could either be flipped up or down whether they were in use or not. While wearing a tattered [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]] and magnispecs in the process of solving programming glitches the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] was experiencing, the [[Color/Legends|blue]] haired [[Zakarisz Ghent]] looked like a [[jolt-head]] from the underbelly of [[Talos City]] as the magnispecs also made his eyes appear larger.<ref name="DN III">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>
